comment: Hand-encoded per-NIM cohort requirements and storage/topology blockers for the ten ARCHVTEAMS-2407 BioNeMo NIM lanes, ordered evidence-first (Boltz2 and OpenFold2 carry fresh fail-closed n=20 cohorts). Provisioned-node statuses are derived from committed lane evidence at the pinned catalog commit; new-preemptible-node cohorts do not exist under the current exact contract for any NIM (the OpenFold2 new-node lane records zero current-contract samples and a newnode-v2-only future execution path), so they are recorded as required, never invented.
new_preemptible_required_default: fail-closed n>=3 lifecycle on a fresh preemptible GPU node under the current exact contract (setup_demand_at/scale dispatch and demand_at/target submission through call_2_response_received_at), including cold image pull, volume attach, prewarm receipts with named storage state, strict semantic validation, full failed-attempt denominator, and exact-ID cleanup; newnode-v2 execution path only, via an approved resource-broker preemptible lease and the shared request-SLO harness

storage_blockers: G-STORAGE applies: direct/O_DIRECT model artifact volume (16.2 GB) plus attached cache volume (13.3 GB) must be content-verified against the promotion tuple before restore
storage attached never implies bytes page-resident; the proven cohort's storage state is 'direct' and any other tier requires its own measured restore
G-STORAGE applies: direct/O_DIRECT model artifact volume must be content-verified against the promotion tuple before restore; the proven cohort's storage state is 'direct'

new_preemptible_node.historical_note: two historical new-node lifecycles passed (of2-newnode-r4-0418, of2-newnode-r5-regional) but are non-poolable under the current exact contract; zero current-contract samples exist and the future execution path is newnode-v2-only

storage_blockers: evidence assumes a buffered, fully prewarmed artifact volume (7.5 GB); unprewarmed or direct-I/O tiers are unmeasured and require their own cohort

provisioned_node.further_required: fresh fail-closed n=20 rerun to the Boltz2/OpenFold2 evidence standard

topology_blockers: GPU-count discrepancy: the lane profile pins a single-H200 configuration while the Terraform catalog requests 2 GPUs for the same image; this must be resolved before any capture qualification
writable state on the production-shaped route is unknown; the state audit is unfinished

provisioned_node.further_required: production-shaped capture and cohort on the pinned digest; deferred pending the explicit owner decision to release the only allowed H200
